5 radio announcements (concert ticket giveaway, horoscope, weather with first snow, carnival parade parking advice, traffic report with jam on A3). Items 5-9 MC3. Key: 5 c, 6 c, 7 b, 8 c, 9 a.

parts.theme: Favours at work and among neighbours
parts.notes: 4 dialogues, each with one R/F (relationship of speakers) and one MC3 (what should X do): boss asks Herr Hamann to work at the weekend; neighbour Frau Knauer asks Herr Förster to empty letterbox; Melanie and Leo (Russian course party, bring DVD); Margit and Susanne (trip to Sardinia by night train). Items 10-17. Key: 10 richtig, 11 a, 12 falsch, 13 a, 14 richtig, 15 b, 16 falsch, 17 c.

Radio survey 'Was finden Sie wichtig für die Gesundheit?': example (exercise) plus 3 speakers (no smoking/little alcohol; health comes with happiness; regular check-ups) matched to statements a-f. Items 18-20. Key: 18 c, 19 e, 20 a.

parts.theme: Finding the right office at the town hall
parts.notes: Rathaus information board (rooms 11-23 with staff and responsibilities: Fundbüro, KFZ-Zulassung, Geburten/Urkunden, An-/Abmeldung, Aufenthaltserlaubnis, Kinderbetreuung, Hundesteuer). Items 21-25: which room (a, b, or 'anderes Zimmer'). Directory text partly garbled in extract. Key: 21 a, 22 c, 23 b, 24 a, 25 b.

5 situations 26-30 to 8 ads a-h plus x (28 daughter wants to give tutoring: no ad): PC-Welt platform, book magazine, tutoring institute, university lecture series on German history (free), language institute seeks teachers, Weiterbildung courses incl. e-mail, VHS Bildungsprämie, Lernstudio ABC (native-speaker teachers, evening courses). Key: 26 c, 27 h, 28 x, 29 d, 30 a.

3 texts, each with one R/F and one MC3: Nordhausen news item on free loan tickets for low-income families; letter from primary school about reading programme (password, consent form); dental insurance letter (60% cost coverage, hand plan to dentist). ~100-130 words each. Items 31-36. Key: 31 falsch, 32 c, 33 falsch, 34 b, 35 richtig, 36 a.

Instruction leaflet for a phone-line answering machine (automatic activation, switching off, remote retrieval with PIN, deleting, free SMS notification). ~250 words. Items 37-39 R/F. Key: 37 richtig, 38 falsch, 39 falsch.
Formal cancellation letter to DB BahnCard-Service (example gap 0 = der). ~60 words, 6 gaps 40-45 x 3 options. Key: 40 b, 41 b, 42 a, 43 a, 44 c, 45 b.

Choose A (reply to former neighbours' invitation to housewarming party; informal) or B (letter to landlord about broken heating, unreachable by phone; formal). 4 points each, salutation and closing required, no word count ('Schreiben Sie möglichst viel'). Model answers given (~90-110 words).
Examiner: 'Würden Sie sich bitte vorstellen?' Prompts: Name, Geburtsort, Wohnort, Arbeit/Beruf, Familie, Sprachen.

2A describe a magazine photo (what do you see, what situation; photos not in extract). 2B talk about 'Computer': own experience, pros/cons, examiner questions (Haben Sie einen Computer? Wozu? Vorteile/Nachteile? Machen Computerspiele abhängig?).
You and partner work in a small firm; plan an after-work party for a colleague's 30th: where, present, food, drinks, whom to invite.
